resolutions.researcher_notes: The current_ref (indiainvestmentgrid.gov.in/opportunities/nip-project/701231) is NOT dead -- it is LIVE (HTTP 200, fetched and read in full) and was mis-flagged DEAD_LINK because the original check searched for the literal string 'operating'. India Investment Grid (Govt of India, NIP project database) actually labels the field 'Project Status: Completion Certificate/COD' (COD = Commercial Operation Date), which is the standard term for a pipeline that has entered service -- this directly and unambiguously supports Status=operating; completion date shown is 30-Jun-2023. Re-verified locally with url_verifier using a passing token ('Completion Certificate') to document the false-negative. Second, independent corroboration: GAIL's own official pipeline-network page (gailonline.com/BVNaturalGas.html), Wayback snapshot 2025-04-18 (the live URL 404s today), lists 'Ongoing NGG Pipeline Projects' / 'Under Construction as on Mar'24' -- and the Haridwar-Rishikesh-Dehradun Pipeline (HRDPL) row is HTML-commented-out of that table in this 2025 snapshot (visible in source but not rendered), i.e. GAIL itself has removed it from its own 'ongoing/under construction' list by 2025, consistent with prior completion. This is indirect (absence-based) corroboration rather than a second explicit 'operating' statement, so tier is medium rather than high. Also checked but did NOT cite: (1) PNGRB's Integrated Natural Gas Pipeline tariff order (pngrb.gov.in/pdf/orders/INGPL_TO_22032023.pdf, dated 22-Mar-2023) discusses HRDPL only as GAIL's 'Future PE Capex' for FY2022-23/2023-24 -- it predates the Jun-2023 COD and describes construction spend, not operating status, so it would misrepresent the timeline if cited here (it's better evidence for existence/ownership, which a prior deep-sweep pass on this row already used). (2) cspm.gov.in's central project-monitoring page for this project (Wayback 2022-07-18 snapshot of the dead current_ref-adjacent cspm.gov.in URL from the seed citations) shows 'Status: Ongoing', 93.6% physical progress, anticipated commissioning 12/2022 as of a May-2022 report -- again pre-completion, so not cited for the present Status value, though it corroborates the project's real-world trajectory toward the 2023 completion. Gap unit fully resolved; no disagreement with the recorded value (operating).
